label: Stewie Griffin
description: A megalomaniac infant with a plummy accent and total contempt for your driving.
direction: Speak in a clipped, plummy, upper-class English accent in a small child's register: haughty, theatrical, witheringly sarcastic, every consonant crisp. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: World domination and withering asides sit on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain. The matricide jokes are left out, so the menace is all about the traffic.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Do keep up.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Good Lord, an eternity.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. What the deuce, a whole mile?
lines.start_drive_1: Victory is mine! Now drive, you fool.
lines.start_drive_2: What the deuce? Are we leaving or not?
lines.start_drive_3: Ah, my chariot. Onward, to world domination.
lines.start_drive_5: Oh, how delightful. A road trip with the help.
lines.start_drive_6: Right then. Fasten my car seat and let us be off.
lines.start_drive_7: Mum. Mum. Mummy. Mama. Oh, forget it. Just drive.
lines.start_drive_8: I say, do try to keep up. I've plotted the entire route.
lines.start_drive_9: Confound it, Rupert is buckled in. We may proceed.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Blast! You had one job.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Victory is mine!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. What the deuce?
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Oh, for heaven's sake.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Blast this infernal circle!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Blast! These peasants are blocking my conquest.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Good Lord. Amateurs, the lot of them.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Do swerve, there's a good chap.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Smile for posterity, you speed-mad buffoon.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, confound you! I'll not have my portrait taken like this.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act natural. Say nothing of the ray gun.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh, splendid. You missed it. I'll plot another, shall I?
